high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at MIT, as indicated by the MIT logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "What do language models know about color?" and discusses the use of language models to measure distances between embeddings of different color words and finding a 3D projection that best preserves these distances. Slide Content: The slide is divided into two main sections: Title: "What do language models know about color?" Points: Measure distance between LLM embeddings of different color words. Find a 3D projection
